note: Walk to the stop, with Not right? open. Seed: php artisan mock:sample-day travel --email=<you>; E2E_EMAIL=<you> MOCK_TRIP=started php artisan db:seed --class="Database\\Seeders\\MockSample\\TravelSeeder". The mock resumes the sample's 13:14 at the same step (its own ?journey=resume); the app shows the seeded trip at the moment's clock. Measuring aids, on both sides alike: a viewport tall enough that the phone's full-screen trip page never scrolls inside itself, and the mock's dashed Sample chip (its own sample tools) taken out of the row and made invisible (still there to pick a moment).

pairs.name: step card
pairs.reason: The mock knows where to stand at Neumarkt ("Gleis 2 (platform), underground"); the app doesn't say a platform it doesn't know (call #9). It holds the look row. The mock names the other lines at Neumarkt from its captured Nearby ("Trams 3, 16 and 18 stop here too: take the 4"); the trip page doesn't know a stop's other lines yet, so it says the mock's own fallback ("Look for 4 Schlebusch"). Under a step title or sub that KVB's longer stop name (see step title) takes onto another line; moved, it lands on another sub-pixel offset.
